_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: 50 - 1.0 x visit - 1.5 x treated x visit + patient intercept (SD 5) + noise (SD 3)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same interaction, standard error, interval, time slope and variance components
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: up to 1.1e-8. harness/longitudinal_examples.test.py checks against closed forms that hold in a balanced random-intercept design: the REML variance components are the ANOVA estimators, and the within-patient effects and their standard errors equal the within (fixed-effects) regression's. At statsmodels' default optimizer settings the patient SD was 3.8e-5 from that exact value.

recovery.claim: the interaction, time slope and both SDs are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Measured by harness/longitudinal_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
